title: Senior Events Manager
description: We're looking for an experienced Senior Events Manager to lead our event execution team. You'll be responsible for end-to-end event management, vendor coordination, and ensuring exceptional attendee experiences.
responsibilities: Plan and execute 15+ networking events annually
Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts
Lead event setup, registration, and post-event analysis
Coordinate with marketing and community teams
Ensure compliance with local regulations
Gather feedback and optimize event experiences
requirements: Proven track record with professional/corporate events
Experience with event software and tools

title: Community Manager
description: Build and nurture our professional community! As Community Manager, you'll be the voice of Social Mate, engaging members and creating meaningful connections both online and at our events.
responsibilities: Manage social media channels and community engagement
Create compelling content for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook
Respond to community inquiries and feedback
Organize virtual networking sessions
Collaborate with events team for promotion
Track and report on community growth metrics
requirements: Content creation and graphic design basics

title: Business Development Associate
description: Join our growing sales team! You'll identify partnership opportunities, connect with corporate clients, and help expand Social Mate's reach in Dubai's thriving business community.
responsibilities: Identify and pitch to potential corporate partners
Build and maintain client relationships
Research market trends and competitor landscape
Attend networking events and industry conferences
Prepare proposals and negotiate sponsorships
Support the sales team with reporting and analytics
requirements: 2+ years of sales or business development experience

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Amplify our brand! As Digital Marketing Specialist, you'll develop and execute marketing campaigns that attract entrepreneurs, professionals, and corporate clients to Social Mate events.
responsibilities: Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns
Manage Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and LinkedIn campaigns
Conduct SEO optimization for website and content
Analyze campaign performance and optimize
Create marketing materials and landing pages
Collaborate with content and events teams
requirements: Experience with Google Analytics and Ads
Adobe Creative Suite or similar (nice to have)
